industry.title:
➟ Dune stablecoin data reveals:

• Stablecoin market reached $304B as of January 2026 (up 49% YoY)
industry.description:
➟ Dune stablecoin data reveals:

• Stablecoin market reached $304B as of January 2026 (up 49% YoY)

• $USDT ($197B) and $USDC ($73B) still hold 89% of the market share

• 172M wallets hold stablecoins, but most newer coins are highly concentrated among a few large holders

• $10.3T in transfer volume occurred in January 2026 (2x YoY)

• Velocity reveals: $USDC turns over 14x daily on @base vs $USDT's 1.4x on $BNB

•  $USDe on Ethereum turns over at just 0.09x daily, while $USDS runs at 0.5x

Big picture:

Stablecoins is core onchain financial fuel: mostly powering trading, liquidity and yield strategies rather than replacing PayPal or remittances at scale (yet).

The infra is maturing fast, institutions are arriving, but risk profiles vary wildly depending on which stable you look at. Aggregate supply numbers hide massive differences in decentralization + usage patterns + fragility.

If you're following stablecoin adoption or DeFi infra, the real alfa is now in these deeper metrics (velocity + classified flows + holder concentration), not just watching total supply go up.

Dune's dataset makes that kind of analysis finally accessible ↓
